answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The counter asks for Verified rope spinner forge warrant first, and a warrant spinners show after yarn trials is the answer it accepts. Before the stamp comes £9 per docket, and 70 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The clerk notes ridge. The tally keeps willow. One river, one entry.
